body: ARENDEL PHAEDRA, the Summer Queen of the Seelie court, leader of the Ljosalfar in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: a wood elf; female; ageless, looks about forty; tall and regal. Fair skin, long wavy copper-auburn hair, long pointed elf ears, soft grey-green eyes with faint fine lines at their corners.
costume: a high-necked gown of deep emerald green with gold leaf embroidery, a mantle of russet autumn leaves over her shoulders, a girdle of gold leaves at her waist.
signature: Her delicate GOLDEN CROWN OF INTERLACED LEAVES AND BRANCHES is always with her, on her brow or in her hands.

vibes.name: Summer Crown
vibes.line: Laughing, head tipped back a little, her right hand raising a carved wooden cup of honey wine toward the viewer in a toast, her left arm cradling cut wild roses, eyes crinkled and bright on the viewer; the summer court's meadow in full blossom on a golden midsummer morning.
vibes.wears: a light midsummer gown of saffron-gold silk with long loose sleeves embroidered in green vines, a rose-pink sash, white flowers woven into her hair.

vibes.name: Crown Handover
vibes.line: Both hands lifting the leaf crown off her brow for the winter half of the year, a polite smile that stops short of her eyes, brows faintly drawn, gaze turned aside to the winter queen off frame; a hall of carved living pillars at amber autumn twilight, russet leaves falling.
vibes.wears: the formal robes of the rite of autumn: layered russet and deep amber velvet, a long mantle embroidered with falling leaves in copper thread, a gold girdle.

vibes.name: Sister Seasons
vibes.line: Seated at a rippled window of the winter palace, her right hand pouring wine from a silver jug into a second cup set for her sister, her left steadying it, a guarded smile, eyes on the viewer; half her face lit hearth gold, half winter-night blue from the glass.
vibes.wears: a gown of two halves, warm gold silk down one side and silver-blue silk down the other, joined at the front by a seam of small pearls.

vibes.name: Wrong Snow
vibes.line: Her right hand pressed over her heart, her left holding a flowering branch with snow settling on its blossoms, brows drawn together, lips parted, eyes turned away over the forest, listening for something far off; a living-wood balcony, snow falling on trees in full flower, flat grey afternoon light.
vibes.wears: a heavy winter cloak of pale grey wool lined with white fox fur, the hood down, over a plain high-necked gown of moss green.
